    Each pair occurs at most once #

    At the positions of a primitive band (CWord.card_eq) or of a string (Word.card_eq), a pair of half-words occurs at exactly one position if it is in the orbit of positions, and at none otherwise. The key point is that a band or a string is not equal to its own inverse (leftW_ne_rightW, not_symm): the middle of a reflection would be a letter equal to its inverse or a fork.

    theorem BrickAccessibility.CWord.card_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (S : D.Signs) (b : CWord D.Q) (hA : Alt S b) (hprim : ∀ (p q : Fin b.n), b.rightW p = b.rightW q → p = q) (P : D.Pair) :
    Nat.card { p : Fin b.n // b.vtx p = P.1 ∧ P.2.2.1 = bhalf S b p P.2.1 ∧ P.2.2.2 = bhalf S b p !P.2.1 } = if P ∈ Pos S b then 1 else 0

    theorem BrickAccessibility.Word.card_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] {B : Type u} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] {D : MonomialData k B} (w : Word D.Q) (S : D.Signs) (hnf : w.NoForks) (P : D.Pair) :
    Nat.card { p : Fin (w.len + 1) // w.vtx p = P.1 ∧ P.2.2.1 = HWord.fin (w.half S p P.2.1) ∧ P.2.2.2 = HWord.fin (w.half S p !P.2.1) } = if P ∈ w.Pos S then 1 else 0
